findings.title: D-038 says the round-18 orphan 450c756 is 'uniformly absent in every clone of the branch', but it is still an unreachable object in the main repository, so a default local `git clone <path>` (the clone method the assignments prescribe) contains it, and the gate validation then reports two extra F-DG0-150/151 closure errors that a --no-local clone does not
findings.reproduction: In the main repository, `git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs` lists `unreachable commit 450c756f679a911b4c736e856fc9dd5e9b2c89a8` and `git for-each-ref --contains 450c756f` lists no ref. `git clone -q /home/user/My-owns c450 && git -C c450 cat-file -e 450c756f…^{commit}` reports the commit present (a local clone hardlinks or copies the whole object store). The same clone with `--no-local` reports it absent (15c-orphan-450c756-clone-modes.log). qa's real-repo dry-run (docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/real-repo-gate-blockers.mjs, which clones --no-local) reports 0 in every PRUNED, RECORD-LESS and DROPPED bucket. My copy of it that differs only in using a plain local clone (r22-dry-run-local-clone.mjs) reports 2 more errors in the 'PRUNED fix_revision not ancestor of its verified round candidate' bucket: 'finding F-DG0-150 (Low): fix 421c922233 is not in the verified round-18 candidate (450c756f67)' and the same for F-DG0-151 (15b-real-repo-dry-run-local-clone.log).
findings.expected: D-038 (and the round-22 common assignment) states that deleting the backup branch leaves 450c756 'uniformly absent in every clone of the branch', which removes the clone dependence of F-DG0-161, so the gate verdict should not depend on how the repository is cloned. Either the unreachable object should actually be gone from the source object store (for example `git reflog expire --expire-unreachable=now --all && git gc --prune=now` in the orchestrator's repository), or D-038 should say that the claim holds only for fetch/--no-local clones, which is how CI and qa's dry-run clone.
findings.actual: The outcome depends on the clone mode until F-DG0-150/151 carry a retained verified round. Impact is limited and fails closed. The local-clone variant only adds errors and never hides one, so it cannot wrongly approve the gate. CI (actions/checkout, fetch-depth: 0) fetches only reachable objects. The two errors should also clear once code-security's round-22 re-verification of F-DG0-150/151 (F-DG0-161) is imported, because their verified round then becomes round 22, whose source_commit 480cd3f contains 421c922. The inaccuracy is in an engineering decision record only. It makes no business, operating-logic or source-provenance claim. I would accept this as a Low observation if the auditor confirms that the gate validation after the round-22 import passes in both clone modes, or if D-038's wording is corrected or the unreachable object is pruned.
